# The four files the two ports share, by digest. This file is byte identical in
# textmorph-ios and textmorph-android, and CI in both compares it against what
# is actually checked in. A divergence is a red build rather than a discovery
# months later.
#
# Regenerating a fixture is a deliberate act: it changes what the port claims to
# be. Updating this file is part of that act, and the diff should say why.
